title: Efficient Algorithms for Cardinality Estimation and Conjunctive Query Evaluation With Simple Degree Constraints
review_status: full-text audit complete; simple-constraint polymatroid LP, proof-sequence bound, flow relaxation, hardness boundary, and current related-work distinctions checked
sections_checked: Theorems 1.1–1.2: polynomial LP and proof sequence
Theorems 1.3–1.5: hardness boundaries and flow bound
Concluding remarks and general-complexity open question
venue_year_verified: PODS 2025; ACM DOI 10.1145/3725233; arXiv first submitted 2025-04-03
evidence_note: For simple constraints |X|≤1, computes the polymatroid bound in polynomial time and constructs an O(k²n²+kn³)-length proof sequence. Nearby mixed classes are as hard as general inputs; a flow-bound relaxation is tractable. General polymatroid-bound complexity remains open. PANDAExpress and CorrBound are later related but distinct axes (downstream query evaluation and richer correlation statistics, respectively).

title: Evaluating the Practical Effectiveness of LLM-Driven Index Tuning on Microsoft SQL Server
review_status: full-text audit complete; workload design, GPT-5 five-call protocol, actual runtime outcomes, DTA comparison, integration and validation costs, and limitations checked
sections_checked: Abstract and four enterprise/TPC-H workload properties
Sections 2–3: SQL Server/DTA baseline, GPT-5 prompts, five independent invocations, timed execution protocol
Single- and multi-query findings, per-call variance, DTA+LLM candidate integration
Validation-cost analysis, conclusion and limitations/future work
venue_year_verified: PVLDB 2026, volume 19 issue 12; arXiv v3 dated 2026-07-27
evidence_note: GPT-5's best among five configurations can outperform SQL Server DTA on a meaningful subset of single-query cases, especially under cost-model errors, but per-call quality varies substantially. DTA is more stable on constructed multi-query workloads; adding LLM indexes to DTA often degrades outcomes. Physical validation/index creation may cost substantially more than tuning. Results are on one DBMS, five workloads, one selected model, and a best-of-five protocol.

venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2026-07-19; no venue independently verified
evidence_note: Theorem supplies sufficient conditions (independent rules, deterministic Eval, fixed conflict resolution) for composable counterfactuals. Empirical comparison 94% vs 45% uses five domains, 50 base cases/domain, five paraphrases each (250 underlying scenarios, 1,250 prompts), but full prompts, temperature, complete scoring, and per-case logs are absent; authors label preliminary. Embedded-vs-client/server and nonofficial/custom benchmark caveats are explicit; DaoQL-Agent and KVCache graph remain future work.
